title: Grade 5 Science — Earth and Its Solar System Neighbors
subject: Science
description: Practice with questions on planets, gravity, orbits, rotation.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Which object is the star at the center of our solar system?
What causes most places on Earth to have day and night?
choices: The Sun orbits Earth each day.
The Moon turns off the Sun.
Earth orbits the Sun each day.

questions.question: About how long does Earth take to complete one orbit around the Sun?
What is the Moon's source of visible light when it shines at night?
Which force keeps planets in orbit around the Sun?
Which planet is nearest the Sun?
What object does Earth's Moon orbit?
Which planet has the greatest diameter?
What is a year on a planet based on?
choices: how long the planet takes to orbit the Sun
how long it takes to spin once

questions.question: Which is one reason seasons differ across Earth's hemispheres at the same time?
choices: A new season starting every day

questions.question: What is a rocky object that orbits the Sun and is smaller than a planet commonly called?
Where are many of the solar system's asteroids found?
choices: between Earth and its Moon only

questions.question: If daylight is ending near you, what is your part of Earth doing?
choices: getting closer to the Sun each minute
rotating away from the direction of the Sun

questions.question: Why does the Sun look much larger than other stars in our sky?
choices: It is the largest star anywhere.
Other stars are inside the Moon.
It is much closer to Earth.

questions.question: Which planet is famous for its large, easily visible ring system?
Why do we see different portions of the Moon lit during its monthly cycle?
choices: Its own light turns on one section at a time.
Its position changes as it orbits Earth.
Earth's shadow covers part of it every night.

questions.question: What does a model with widely spaced planets try to show?
choices: what all planet surfaces feel like
the large distances in the solar system

questions.question: Which pair includes two rocky planets?
What device helps scientists see distant planets in detail?
Which happens once per complete spin of Earth?
choices: Most places pass through a daily light-and-dark cycle.
Earth's Moon always returns to the same phase.
